transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?
I’ve just been really tired. Like… not normal tired. Sleep doesn’t seem to fix it, and getting through work and then dinner at home feels harder than it should.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?
Yeah… I guess so. Most mornings lately I wake up with this kind of heavy, gray feeling, like the day’s already disappointing before it’s even started.
Have you been enjoying things less than usual lately?
Yeah… I have. I usually like painting, and going through museum exhibits, but lately I just… don’t. My supplies are just sitting there, and I can’t really make myself care enough to go.
Have you had thoughts that life isn’t worth living, or thoughts of harming yourself?
I… I don’t know. I don’t think I’d say that exactly. I’ve just been tired and kind of worn down, but… I haven’t really wanted to talk about it like that.
Are you having thoughts of killing yourself?
I… don’t really know how to answer that. I don’t think so. I’m just… tired.
How long have you been feeling this way?
About a month, I think. It kind of shifted from me being really energized and driven to… this low feeling that hasn’t really let up.
During that energized period, did you need much less sleep than usual and still feel rested?
Yeah… I guess so. I was sleeping maybe four hours, but I’d still wake up feeling ready to start emailing or planning things, or even reorganize the kitchen.
During that energized period, did you feel more confident or powerful than usual?

Maybe… yeah. I mean, I felt like I could sort of fix everything. Work morale, stuff at home… like if people would just follow my plan, it would all get better. Looking back, that was probably a bit much.
During that energized period, were you talking more than usual?
Yeah… apparently I was. My husband said I was talking really fast, and a couple people at work said I kept jumping in before they could finish.
During that energized period, were you more active or taking on more projects than usual?

Yeah… I was taking on a lot. For a couple weeks I was kind of bouncing between work projects, calls for the art committee, and then all these home organization ideas. It felt like I couldn’t really slow down.
During that energized period, did you do anything unusually risky or impulsive, like spending much more money than usual?
I don’t think so… not really. I mean, I may have bought a few things for organizing at home, but nothing I’d call risky or wildly out of character.
During that energized period, did it cause serious problems at work or at home?

Not serious, I don’t think. I was still going to work and taking care of things at home. But… I guess I was slower making decisions, and my family probably couldn’t count on me as much for plans. I also pulled back from the art stuff a bit, which isn’t like me.
About how many days in a row did that energized period last?
It’s a little hard to pin down, but… the whole shift has been about a month, I think. The more energized part was maybe a couple weeks of that.
Before this past month, have you ever had another period in your life when you felt depressed like this for days or longer?
Yes… I’ve had that before. The longest one I can really remember was maybe around five months, where I just felt low and tired most days… not really like myself.
During that five-month period, did the low mood last most of the day nearly every day for at least two weeks?
Yeah… I think so. Most days I’d wake up with this heavy, gray feeling, like the day was already kind of ruined before it started. It was there a lot of the day.
During that energized period, were you ever hospitalized because of it?
No… I wasn’t hospitalized for it.
During that energized period, did it ever get so severe that you couldn't function normally at work or at home?

Not really to the point that I couldn’t function. I was still getting to work and taking care of things at home… but I guess I was slower with decisions, not as dependable with family plans, and I pulled back from my art stuff some.
During that energized period, did you have any hallucinations or strongly held beliefs that others said were not true?
No… I don’t think so. I didn’t hear or see things, and I don’t remember having beliefs like that.
During that five-month low period, were you also having a time when you felt unusually energized or revved up?

Yeah… earlier that month I did have a stretch where I felt kind of unusually up, like very charged. I thought I was full of great ideas, and then I’d get irritated pretty quickly if my husband questioned what I was planning.
At any other time in your life, apart from when you were depressed, have you had a period where you felt unusually energized or revved up like that?

I mean… the main time I can think of was earlier that month. I felt unusually charged, kind of upbeat, like my ideas were brilliant, and then I’d get irritated pretty fast if my husband questioned what I was planning. Other than that, I’m not really sure.
